question: What is the meaning of collection in relation to transportation and logistics?
description: Collection refers to the gathering of materials or products for transportation, typically at the end-of-life phase of a product or building. In a circular economy, the aim is to keep materials and products in circulation for as long as possible, but collection is necessary for recycling or other end-of-life processes. Transportation and logistics are involved in every life cycle stage, including collection.
